public_claim_boundary: Template only; not Harbor parity evidence, not Harbor execution evidence, not external review evidence, and not v1 readiness.
required_inputs: real Harbor runs from the packaged adapter
matching task ids or redacted private-pack fingerprint
public-safe redaction and privacy scan status
blocked_until: generated dataset passes a real Harbor run
matching original AuthZBench-SaaS run evidence exists
parity rows are computed from real run artifacts
